Subject: PrivDeploy packaging question: migration allowance and SRE windows

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re broadly aligned on the Private deployment (VPC) path but procurement has pushed back on two commercial items we need clarified before we can move to legal: 1) a one-time migration allowance to offset our migration services (we estimate ~$60–90k for the first-phase cutover), and 2) the exact SRE coverage ladder (response and escalation windows) tied to platform fee tiers.

Two quick questions:
- Is a migration allowance something Redwood can grant as a credit on the first invoice or a separate line item on the SOW?
- Can you confirm whether SRE response windows are exclusively business-hours or if an on-call after-hours option exists as part of a higher support tier?

We’re targeting a decision by EOD Aug 18 so appreciate a quick outline we can circulate internally. I’ve cc’d Sanjay from procurement — he’ll follow up on invoicing treatment.

—Aaron

Subject: Re: PrivDeploy packaging question: migration allowance and SRE windows

Aaron —

Good questions, and absolutely doable to give you a clear path. High-level proposal below (happy to iterate):

1) Migration allowance:  We can provide a one-time migration credit equal to a fixed dollar amount (recommended: $75,000) applied to the first invoice under the Private deployment SOW. The credit is not refundable but will be applied up-front to reduce your initial invoice. If Helix converts parts of the workload to Redwood Hosted within the first 12 months, the credit will be subject to a modest clawback schedule (50% in year 1, 25% in year 2) to cover amortized implementation subsidies.

2) Conversion credits: If you commit to a 3-year private deployment volume/commit, we can layer in conversion credits for later hosted migrations (4% of committed platform fee per year, vesting annually). This is optional but helps preserve flexibility.

3) SRE ladder: Base support (included in platform fee) = business-hours (Mon–Fri, 9–5 local). Premium SRE tier (add-on) = 24x7 on-call with guaranteed response SLAs (P1 < 1 hour, P2 < 4 hours). We’ll include a sample support matrix in the SOW.

I’ve attached a short SOW stub and flagged the sections where the migration allowance and SRE tiers live. Marissa — I’d appreciate if you could add a line-item breakdown (platform fee, migration credit, and premium SRE price) and push back a suggested payment schedule.

If this sounds reasonable, we’ll capture the exact wording in the SOW and route for signatures.

Thanks,

Putting numbers behind Naomi’s outline so you have something to take to procurement. Attached: PrivDeploy_Support_Tiers.xlsx with line-item pricing. Highlights:
- One-time migration allowance (proposed credit): $75,000 (applied to first invoice).
- Base platform fee (annual): $900,000 (includes base support, monitoring, console).

Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

- On the migration allowance clawback: procurement would prefer a simpler 12-month cliff (100% credit applies if Helix remains on Private for at least 12 months; otherwise the credit is invoiced back). Is Redwood open to that instead of the 50/25 schedule?

- On SRE: the P1 <1h response SLA is great — can you confirm whether any remediation time in the premium SRE tier is included as part of the $120k (you mentioned 200 incident minutes), and how escalation to our internal on-call will be coordinated? We need that spelled out in the SOW (who owns the first responder vs. platform remediation).

Aaron —

Appreciate the close read. We can accept the 12-month cliff for the migration allowance (simpler for both sides). Final commercial concessions below — I’ll instruct legal to mirror this language in the SOW: 

- Migration allowance: $75,000 one-time implementation subsidy. Applied as a separate line item on the SOW and invoiced as a $0‑net line (credit) on the first invoice. If customer terminates or transitions workload off Private within 12 months of SOW effective date, Redwood will invoice Helix for the full $75,000.

- Premium SRE tier: $120,000/year includes 24x7 on-call staffing, response SLAs (P1 < 1 hour, P2 < 4 hours), and up to 200 minutes/year of hands-on remediation included in the subscription. Remediation beyond included minutes will be billed at $250/hour. Escalation model: Redwood SRE is first responder for platform-level incidents; Helix on-call will be paged for application-level troubleshooting per the runbook (we’ll include the runbook as an attachment to the SOW).
